# Knife-Life

> > A comprehensive Japanese knife e-commerce platform offering authentic kitchen knives, detailed guides on blade types and materials, and curated selections from renowned Japanese knife makers.

Knife-Life specializes in premium Japanese kitchen knives, providing both a product catalog and educational resources for professional chefs and home cooks. The site features detailed guides on knife types, steel composition, corrosion resistance, and major Japanese knife brands including Goko Hamono, Hokiyama, and Sakai Takayuki.

- Japanese kitchen knives

- Professional kitchen knives
- Knife brands

- Kurotori Hamono
